The '''GT-27 Plasma Core Assault Cannon''' was a model of personal [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The GT-27 Plasma Core Assault Cannon was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Mid Rim Explorer Pack, which was released to the Cartel Market on [[June 9]], [[2015]].<ref name="SW TOR" />
